newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN OLOS MESMERISED BY DOLLAR.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN OLOS MESMERISED BY DOLLAR.

text.p: Belgian linear bonds were slightly firmer with Bunds on Monday with players kept on their toes by fears of renewed dollar strength that might force the German Bundesbank into an interest rate rise.
"We'll have to learn to live with that fear," one trader said. "The dollar went down because of U.S. bond selling but the upward trend is not finished yet," he said.

At 0825 GMT the benchmark 2007 OLO yielded 5.78 percent against 5.79 percent at the close on Friday as the market was profiting from the weaker dollar which reduced the possibility of a Buba rate rise as early as Tuesday.
